snippet.title: Close to Light - Wishlist now on Steam!
snippet.description:
Close to Light is a rhythm game in which you have to follow the lights along with the music while avoiding danger and darkness.

Wishlist Close to Light on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4209820/Close_to_Light/

Play a demo version on Itch: https://nertsal.itch.io/close-to-light

OST Far from Dark available on SoundCloud: https://soundcloud.com/icylava/far-from-dark?utm_campaign=social_sharing

Close to Light Discord server: https://discord.gg/DXZgEzEahu
